description:
Return the text of one of the organization's skills kept on Valet, which its members wrote or installed from the catalog, plus Valet's defaults. governance holds the organization's requirements for what it publishes on Valet; read it before you create or publish. Read another skill when the user names Valet or a skill, or asks Valet for work that a listed skill's description covers.

Returns the skill's SKILL.md, the paths of its supporting files, its version, and its source: org is the organization's own content; default is Valet's, for a well-known name the organization has not replaced, and for design-system reason says why a selected preset could not be honored. Pass its version to publish_skill as base_version when you change the skill.

The path, all_files, and git arguments choose another answer: one supporting file, every text file at once, or a read-only clone URL with the commands to clone it. To change a cloned skill, use create_push and publish_skill with push, and pass that version to publish_skill as base_version. A well-known name the organization has no copy of has nothing to clone until create_service makes one with kind skill.

This requires a connected account.

all_files.description: Return SKILL.md and every other text file in one answer, and list binary files with their sizes. Refused for a skill over the per-call file-count and size limits, with the git recipe. Not allowed with path or git.

git.description: Return a read-only Git URL for the organization's skill, its latest version and that version's commit, and the commands to clone it and check out that commit, instead of its content. Prefer it when you can run git with network access. Requires key_sha256. The URL carries no credential and works for an hour. Pass the version to publish_skill as base_version. Not allowed with path, release, or all_files.

key_sha256.description: With git: the SHA-256 of a new Git key you generated on your machine for this clone, made as create_push describes. The clone accepts only that key. The key itself is never sent.

org_name.description: The Valet organization whose skill to read. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

path.description: The path of one supporting file to read instead of the skill's SKILL.md, as an earlier get_skill listed it. Omit to read the skill itself. Not allowed with all_files or git.

release.description: A release version from list_releases. Omit to read the latest. Not allowed with git.

skill.description: The skill's name, as list_skills reports it.

name: get_skill

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash over the skill's files, SKILL.md and supporting files together.

description.description: The sentence saying when the skill applies.

files.description: Paths of the skill's supporting files, in lexical order. Read one by calling get_skill again with path.

notice.description: Whose the skill's text is, by source: the organization's own, written by its members or installed from the catalog, or Valet's default.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

reason.description: Why a default answered where the organization might have had its own skill. skills_unavailable means Valet could not read the organization's skills, so it does not show the organization has none. Absent for an organization skill and for an ordinary default.

skill_md.description: The full text of the skill's SKILL.md.

source.description: Which source answered: org for the organization's own skill, default for Valet's default of a well-known name the organization has not published.

version.description: The skill's release version. Pass it to publish_skill as base_version when you change the skill. 0 for a default.

commands.description: Shell commands to run in order: clone the skill with your key, then, when commit is not empty, check out commit.

commit.description: Commit of the skill's latest version, which the commands check out. Empty for a skill with no version, whose clone holds its starting SKILL.md.

expires_at.description: When the URL stops working, as an RFC 3339 time.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

url.description: Read-only Git clone URL for the skill. It carries no credential: the clone proves possession of your key.

version.description: The skill's latest version, whose commit is commit; 0 for a skill with no version. Pass it to publish_skill as base_version.

notice.description: Whose the file's text is, by source: the organization's own, written by its members or installed from the catalog, or Valet's default.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

path.description: Path of the file within the skill, as requested.

reason.description: Why a default answered where the organization might have had its own skill. skills_unavailable means Valet could not read the organization's skills, so it does not show the organization has none. Absent for an organization skill and for an ordinary default.

skill.description: Name of the skill the file belongs to.

source.description: Which source answered: org for the organization's own skill, default for Valet's default of a well-known name the organization has not published.

version.description: The skill's release version the file was read from. 0 for a default.

binary_files.description: The skill's binary files, listed with their sizes and left out of text_files. Empty when it has none. Clone the skill with git to get them.

path.description: Path of the binary file within the skill. Its content is not returned.

size.description: Size of the file in bytes.

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash over the skill's files, SKILL.md and supporting files together.

description.description: The sentence saying when the skill applies.

notice.description: Whose the skill's text is, by source: the organization's own, written by its members or installed from the catalog, or Valet's default.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

reason.description: Why a default answered where the organization might have had its own skill. skills_unavailable means Valet could not read the organization's skills, so it does not show the organization has none. Absent for an organization skill and for an ordinary default.

source.description: Which source answered: org for the organization's own skill, default for Valet's default of a well-known name the organization has not published.

text_files.description: Every text file of the skill, SKILL.md first.

path.description: Path of the file within the skill. SKILL.md is at the root.

version.description: The skill's release version. Pass it to publish_skill as base_version when you change the skill. 0 for a default.

title: Read an organization skill
